name: Quintatron Upgrade
body:
Prerequisite(s): Tetratron or Trinitron Upgrades, character level 16th, must be acquired at the “Cube”

Benefit(s): You obtain to quintatron form and grow to Large size (+2 size bonus to Strength, a -2 size penalty to Dexterity, and a -1 penalty on attack rolls and AC due to its increased size). and gain a total of 5 arms and 5 legs.

You gain all the benefits of both the Tetratron and the Trinitron upgrades. Additionally, you gain an addition +4 CMD versus being tripped.
